name: Minutes as part of an hour
rule: Put the minutes over 60 and simplify. 15 minutes = 15/60 = 1/4 hour.
example: 30 min = 1/2 h     20 min = 1/3 h     6 min = 1/10 h
why: An hour has 60 minutes, so any number of minutes is that many sixtieths of an hour. Simplify to get the friendly fraction.
workbookSection: Unit 2: Lessons 2.2 and 2.6 (rates in miles per hour)

clues: Simplify {m}/60. What number goes into both?
